ModMetaData.name: 带宽转接基站 / Mechanitor Bandwidth Relay
ModMetaData.author: WhiteGiverMa
ModMetaData.description: 建造带宽转接基站，在同地图连接两名己方机械师，划拨空余带宽。连好后，离图或加入远行队也能继续转接。两人的控制组和机兵归属不变。建筑复用原版生物技术 DLC 的频带节点外观。\n\nBuild a bandwidth relay to link two player mechanitors on its map and lend spare bandwidth. Established links keep working on other maps and in caravans. Does not move mechs or control groups. Uses the vanilla Biotech band node art.
